entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of those on every plane who run toward danger.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel worshipped on Innistrad, before whom even storm clouds are said to bow.

entities.name: Elder Rimheit
entities.description: A speaker who says even storm clouds bow to worship Avacyn.

entities.name: Darien
entities.description: The last king of Kjeldor, who fulfilled his dream of unification; those who followed were known as the kings of New Argive.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: A kingdom whose last king was Darien.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: The realm whose kings followed Darien.

entities.name: Manfried Ulmach
entities.description: Chief Inquisitor who says a boon from the angels should never be cast aside.

entities.name: Grakk
entities.description: A creature who felt a little warm and fuzzy inside for the first time in his life.

entities.name: Hedrax
entities.description: A figure who stepped into oblivion and welcomed the unwavering silence.

entities.name: Vennick of the Gateless
entities.description: A guildless speaker who says they can fend for themselves.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: A home city threatened by an unhallowed horde.

entities.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
entities.description: A defender of Thraben who will not see it fall to the unhallowed horde.

entities.name: Takara
entities.description: A speaker who offers to show Eladamri the secrets within secrets.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: A leader at whose summons tribal rivalries and petty disputes were laid aside.

entities.name: Pelyus
entities.description: A vedalken ordinar who says the Origin Query will wait.

entities.name: Lu Su
entities.description: An ally of Kongming in the trick on the Wei troops.

entities.name: Wei
entities.description: Troops tricked into shooting arrows and later opposed at Red Cliffs.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A cat warrior who followed Crovax's skulking form despite wanting to rest.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A figure whose skulking form Mirri followed.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A speaker who calls something terrifying but thankfully temporary.

entities.name: Naimah
entities.description: A Femeref philosopher.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: An expedition leader who speaks of a guide who knows every step of the coastline.

entities.name: Pol Jamaar
entities.description: An illusionist who speaks of a phantasmal bear.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem who says he twice let the Legacy slip away.

entities.name: Fblthp
entities.description: A character who had always hated crowds.

entities.name: Politus
entities.description: A vedalken emisar who says true strength is in the mind.

entities.name: Dusk Legion
entities.description: Explorers who ransacked tombs and temples in Orazca.

entities.name: Queen Marchesa
entities.description: A queen who jokes about the personal touch of murder.

entities.name: Meloku the Clouded Mirror
entities.description: A speaker who comments on the nezumi doing things for money.

entities.name: Sheoldred, Whispering One
entities.description: A Phyrexian who says to behold blessed perfection.

entities.name: Senifet
entities.description: Vizier of Bontu.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A god whose favorites will stand highest in eternity.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of rage in every heart.

entities.name: Lovisa Coldeyes
entities.description: A Balduvian leader who speaks of fighting for blood and of burning the villages of Kjeldor.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A warrior adept.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: A planeswalker who never believed in using her inside voice.

entities.description: Reveled while Theros burned.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane that burned while Xenagos reveled.

entities.name: Houn
entities.description: A Jeskai elder who says a former Mardu must now train his mind.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A task mage who says to be grateful for mana without questioning its source.

entities.name: Rahilda
entities.description: Vildin-Pack alpha.

entities.name: Azusa
entities.description: A monk who considers Kamigawa and its people her family and home.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Azusa's home.

entities.name: Gamelen
entities.description: A Citanul elder.

entities.name: Dejara
entities.description: A Giltwood druid.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: A Gruul cyclops who cheers for meat and eggs.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of the pack's need bred in the bone.

entities.name: Harak
entities.description: A Malakir bloodwitch.

entities.name: Brion Stoutarm
entities.description: A giant among flying boggarts.

entities.name: Bolas
entities.description: An ancient dragon planeswalker whose world-bending machinations near triumph; Dominaria's most ancient evil.

entities.name: Ranalus
entities.description: A vedalken heretic who found enlightenment in a coatl's scales.

entities.description: A planeswalker who set a bomb and whispered that Yawgmoth would pay for his treachery.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A figure accused of treachery by Freyalise.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: A speaker who says he needed a hand.

entities.name: Glissa Sunseeker
entities.description: An elf who asks what remains to be saved if they defeat the Sundering Titan.

entities.name: Kenjek
entities.description: Captain of the Thousand Swords.

entities.name: Talara
entities.description: An elvish safewright.

entities.name: Mishra

events.summary: Gideon Jura says that on every plane there are those who run toward danger.
events.quote: "On every plane, there are those who run toward danger."

events.summary: Elder Rimheit declares that even storm clouds bow to worship Avacyn.
events.quote: "Even storm clouds bow to worship Avacyn."

events.summary: Darien fulfilled his dream of unification and became the last king of Kjeldor; his successors were the kings of New Argive.
events.quote: With his dream of unification fulfilled, Darien became the last king of Kjeldor.

events.summary: Grakk felt warm and fuzzy inside for the first time in his life.
events.quote: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

events.summary: Hedrax stepped into oblivion and welcomed the silence.
events.quote: As Hedrax stepped into oblivion, he welcomed the unwavering silence.

events.summary: Thalia vows not to see Thraben fall to the unhallowed horde.
events.quote: "Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde."

events.summary: Vennick of the Gateless declares the guildless can fend for themselves.
events.quote: "Guilds be damned. We can fend for ourselves."

events.summary: Takara tells Eladamri she has seen secrets within secrets and offers to show him.
events.quote: "I have seen and heard much here. There are secrets within secrets. Let me show you."

events.summary: Kongming and Lu Su tricked Wei troops into shooting over 100,000 arrows at them, to use against the Wei at Red Cliffs.
events.quote: Kongming and Lu Su tricked Wei troops into shooting over 100,000 arrows at them to later use against the Wei at Red Cliffs.

events.summary: Mirri follows Crovax's skulking form despite wanting rest.
events.quote: All Mirri wanted to do was rest, but she couldn't ignore a nagging suspicion as she followed Crovax's skulking form.

events.summary: Karn vows not to let the Legacy slip away a third time.
events.quote: "Twice I have let the Legacy slip away. Never again."

events.summary: Once they reached Orazca, the Legion's explorers ransacked tombs and temples hunting for the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Once they reached Orazca, the Legion's explorers ransacked tombs and temples, hunting for the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: Lovisa Coldeyes says the villages of Kjeldor burn in retaliation.
events.quote: "The embers of our homes still smolder, and already the villages of Kjeldor burn in retaliation."

events.summary: Xenagos reveled while Theros burned.
events.quote: Xenagos reveled while Theros burned.

events.summary: Bolas's world-bending machinations reach their triumph.
events.quote: After years of world-bending machinations, Bolas's triumph is at hand.

events.summary: Eladamri's summons caused tribal rivalries to be laid aside.
events.quote: Tribal rivalries and petty disputes were laid aside at Eladamri's summons.

events.summary: Freyalise sets a bomb, whispering that Yawgmoth will pay for his treachery.
events.quote: "Yawgmoth," Freyalise whispered as she set the bomb, "now you will pay for your treachery."

events.summary: Glissa Sunseeker asks what remains to be saved even if the Sundering Titan is defeated.
events.quote: "Even if we defeat it, what remains to be saved?"

events.summary: Mishra's creations still toil in remote areas performing their last orders after the factories were destroyed.
events.quote: With their factories long destroyed, some of Mishra's creations still toil in remote areas
